findings.title: Upstream metadata CC BY 4.0 was omitted from the repository-wide license/citation scope

evidence.observation: Original heading grouped code and catalog presentation under MIT; metadata section mentioned only retained MIT notice.
MIT notice explicitly covers EyeDataHub library code itself.
Fixed README separately licenses catalog metadata under CC BY 4.0. Archive copy and live v0.7.0 raw README matched byte-for-byte.
Sharing requires retained creator/source/license information and indication of modifications.

findings.suggested_fix: Scope original software to MIT, upstream/derived catalog to CC BY 4.0, preserve full upstream citation and modification history, exclude independently licensed images/provider material. Do not treat catalog license as permission to redistribute every archive/cache file.

findings.status: Open; README scope belongs to parent
findings.title: China-Fundus-CIMT original/raw wording should distinguish publisher preprocessing from local non-modification

evidence.observation: Uses original-data-image wording and says the sample was not cropped or re-encoded.
None / source bytes preserved correctly describes this repository transformation, but not acquisition-raw status.

evidence.locator: Data preprocessing / Image cropping and renaming; Data quality control
evidence.observation: Publisher removed information borders, standardized/cropped to 512 x 512 and applied restoration to some low-quality images; selected sample restoration status not established.

findings.suggested_fix: Say unmodified official distributed sample / 未由本仓库修改的官方分发样例. Add that original publisher preprocessing is present; avoid asserting raw camera pixels or no prior crop. Retain source-byte hashes and current no-local-change declaration.

findings.status: Optional reference improvement, not a demonstrated license failure
findings.title: OCTDL dataset creator list differs from requested article citation

evidence.observation: 10 dataset creators; article citation includes Paul A. Constable as an eleventh author and orders Ronkin/Borisov differently.
Official repository requests full paper citation including Paul A. Constable.

findings.suggested_fix: Keep the correct ten-author dataset-release attribution and optionally add a separate complete 11-author paper citation, clearly labeled. Do not claim the dataset release creator list itself is wrong.

findings.status: Observed limitation; existing manifest already acknowledges MCFI key/date
findings.title: Manifest provenance remains linkable to source participant tables despite absence of visible/EXIF identifiers

evidence.observation: Original member path includes participant key, acquisition date and time; these can join upstream metadata.
Provider documents ID/date/time naming and participant-level metadata table.

evidence.path: private local image-metadata audit record (not redistributed)
evidence.observation: No EXIF identity data; only OCTDL Orientation. PNGs have no text/EXIF chunks; JPEG headers contain no other APP identity/comment payloads.

findings.suggested_fix: Keep privacy wording limited to the inspected bytes/visible content, preserve the existing pseudonymous-linkage caveat, and do not label the samples irreversibly anonymous or consent-verified solely because a CC license exists. No newly exposed direct identifier was found.

findings.title: Historical EyeDataHub DOI archival API currently returns 410

evidence.observation: HTTP 410 Gone observed on 2026-11-06; the DOI is present in the frozen upstream CITATION.cff.

findings.suggested_fix: Retain the historical upstream DOI as supplied, prefer fixed Git commit and SHA hashes for reproduction, and avoid asserting that it currently serves a downloadable archive.
